correctness.rationale: For real X_8 with N(s,u)=max(|s|,|u|,(|s|+|u|)/sqrt(2)), the defining primary source Lemma 4.1 and Proposition 4.2 reduce every isosceles unit pair to the 1-variable Phi(t) quotient. Signed-coordinate and swap symmetries imply Phi(t)=Phi(1/t). On 0<=t<=1 the exact active norm facets switch at d=5sqrt(2)-7, a=sqrt(2)-1, c=(5sqrt(2)-1)/7. The four rational pieces and exact derivatives are reconstructed independently: (t^2+9)/10 with derivative t/5; (3t^2+14t+17)/20 with derivative (3t+7)/10; (3t^2+14t+17)/(10(1+t)^2) with derivative -2(2t+5)/(5(1+t)^3); and (5t^2+8t+5)/(5(1+t)^2) with derivative 2(t-1)/(5(1+t)^3). Endpoint norm facets hold exactly, and convexity of each competing |affine| norm facet guarantees the active branch throughout each interval. Therefore strictly rising before a, strictly falling after a except zero derivative at t=1, and reciprocal symmetry yields exactly t=a and t=1/a. The explicit unit pair x=(1,a),y=(-a,1) has ||x±y||=sqrt(2), ||x+2y||=||2x+y||=1+sqrt(2), giving Omega=(3+2sqrt(2))/5. Independently the source general upper bound 2/5+J^2/10+2J/5 with J(X_8)=sqrt(2) yields the same upper value. A separate SymPy checker confirmed 32 exact endpoint-facet evaluations, all branch formulas, derivative identities, and the extremal pair; no finite sampling was used as a continuum proof.

value.rationale: The regular octagon is a canonical fourfold-symmetric intermediate between the square and Euclidean disk, and the Liu–Yang–Fu–Li constant is a natural precise measure of isosceles-orthogonal parallelogram geometry. An exact calibrated benchmark and the complete four-facet transition/unique parameter-maximizer profile are useful for comparison with other regular polygonal Banach planes (a published-finding analogue for the dodecagon is already available). This is genuinely narrower and more elementary than a general theorem, and the bare value alone can be derived rapidly from the known James bound plus a sharp pair. The full profile, however, describes nontrivial facet changes in the optimization and pinpoints where equality occurs; thus the accepted mathematical value lies in complete object-specific classification, not a novel global inequality.
residual_risks: Small object-specific exact benchmark with modest reach, not a regular-4n-gon formula.
The value could be regarded as routine if divorced from the full exact profile and optimizer uniqueness; significance should not be exaggerated.
